title: forecast_get
description: A device on the hub path (parental controls or the effective rule control_path hub; with a key it reads Home Assistant itself away from home) asks for the forecast of one visible weather entity (weather.get_forecasts). Answer forecast with the same request_id; failures are control_error (not_hub_controlled, not_visible, invalid_request = not a weather entity or the type is not supported, ha_error, ha_unavailable, rate_limited). Same visibility as state_subscribe.
